trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work through the checklist; progress made during the story already counts [1][4]

The checklist is lenient (~60% true completion): 100 optional missions, 200/277 vehicle scans, 100/255 animal studies, 15/18 meditations, 70/80 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 WAiNK scans; full completion is required only for robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's Target Decks [1][4][8]
PowerPyx, GTABase and KeenGamer rank this as the hardest trophy [1][4][8]

Track progress by region in Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots [1]
100% needs 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 [1][4]

Check what is left in Progress > Activities; most come naturally during the story and 100% work [1]

All quests remain available after the story [1]

steps: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams; he marks treasure chests at seven shipwrecks — dive, use the metal detector to dig up treasure, and bring it back [1][4]
He goes quiet after Chapter 1 but texts Jason later (Chapters 2–3), so it is not missable; track it in Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures [1][4]

The final meditation is available after both characters can play together (after Chapter 2, Coffee Break) [1]
Sources disagree about whether this is missable; treat it as missable and do the Chapter 1 meditation [1][2][3][4][5][8][9][13][16]

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

Boost Focus with food, drinks, washing or showering, and Adrenaline; use an assault rifle and body armor against five gang members at an operation [1]
Gang members count; soldiers, police and civilians do not appear to count [1][5]
Focus Level 4 makes this easier and rises through ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots [1]

Back the plane to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) from the airport [1]

Use the Snap Gun at a back door without kicking it; find the safe-code note, loot the safe, destroy security footage and disable the alarm [1]
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds is a good location; the trophy unlocks shortly after leaving [1]

disagreements.title: Is anything missable?
disagreements.positions: PowerPyx, GTABase, sixshore, KeenGamer, Mobalytics, GTA Scoop and EGamers flag #28 as possibly missable; Push Square says none known; planetgta6 cannot tell yet.
disagreements.call: Treat #28 as missable; do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation.

disagreements.title: Time to platinum
disagreements.positions: About 200 h (PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer, GTA Scoop); 200–250+ h (sixshore); 250+/300 h (Push Square).
disagreements.call: ~200 h is the modal estimate; 300 h is the high outlier.

disagreements.title: Maximum Withdrawal #40 Silver or Bronze?
disagreements.positions: Silver: PSN via planetgta6 and 13 sources; Bronze: Push Square only.

disagreements.title: Shooting-range locations 12 or 2?
disagreements.positions: 12 ranges / 42 challenges (PowerPyx, GTABase, GameTrek); 2 locations (Push Square).

disagreements.title: Hidden count 28 or 27? (Personal Best #47)
disagreements.positions: 28 hidden (PSN, GTABase, sixshore, Insider Gaming); 27 (Push Square does not mark Personal Best hidden).

disagreements.title: #7 “final mission” or “Chapter 5”?
disagreements.positions: “Complete the final mission” (PSN and all other sources); “Complete Chapter 5” (Insider Gaming only).

disagreements.title: Gamerscore values differ
disagreements.positions: Varied TrueAchievements-sourced values (planetgta6, sixshore, GTABase); flat Silver 50G / Bronze 10G (Of Zen and Computing).

disagreements.title: onemoregame.ph grade split is wrong
disagreements.positions: Claims 1P/3G/14S/18B = 36, not 55; lists The Shootist as Bronze.

disagreements.title: GameTrek chapter numbers off by one
disagreements.positions: GameTrek claims Paradise Lost = Chapter 2 and T**s Ass Drug Money = Chapter 3.
disagreements.call: Use PSN chapters: Paradise Lost = Chapter 1, T**s Ass Drug Money = Chapter 2.
